summary: Applies Google's people-generation safety policy. The legal value depends on both region and input mode, so this is provider policy plumbing rather than a stable user preference.
combines: Text-to-video and extension normally require allow_all, while image, last-frame, and reference-image conditioning require allow_adult.
In the EU, UK, Switzerland, and MENA, Veo 3 and 3.1 accept allow_adult only; the provider's restricted regional profile overrides the normal text-mode value.
Lixpi derives this field after it knows whether the request is text-only, frame-conditioned, or an extension.

usage.from: the registered Google moderation profile plus the request's text, image-conditioned, or extension mode
usage.what: Derives the legal people-generation policy after the provider knows the input mode and configured regional profile.
